newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: L.Champalimaud replaces A.Dias as BTA, CPP head.
newsitem.headline: L.Champalimaud replaces A.Dias as BTA, CPP head.

text.p: Luis Champalimaud replaced Alipio Dias as head of Portuguese banks Banco de Totta e Acores (BTA) and Credito Predial Portugues (CPP), both of which are owned by Champalimaud's father Antonio, a statement said.
Luis Champalimaud's new appointments mean he now heads a total of four banks owned by his father. He is already president of Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor and Chemical SGPS SA.
BTA shares dropped six percent to a low of 3,000 escudos in trade on Lisbon bourse on Friday after Portuguese weekly Semanario Economico reported that Dias was stepping down.
BTA closed at 3,030 escudos, down 171, in volume of 500,325 shares.
Some dealers said it was feared Dias's resignation could signal a break with the bank's past policy of paying out high dividends.
"The sellers are afraid that the departure of Alipio Dias is synonymous with a change in the policy of good dividends," said one dealer.
